answer: An attester must stake 30% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the ridge stake is held until the lantern settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the quartz audit lists each exposure. A farm running 182 keys as a result pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap.
